title: A Mobile Brain/Body Imaging Platform for the Assessment and Optimization of Post-stroke Overground Robotic Gait Treatments
official: A Mobile Brain/Body Imaging Platform for the Assessment and Optimization of Post-stroke Overground Robotic Gait Treatments
summary: The study aims to identify neural biomarkers that can be used to monitor the recovery of locomotion and movement of post-stroke patients, both in natural settings and with enriched treatment using robotic device. These biomarkers could potentially be utilized in clinical practice to improve recovery outcomes. Additionally, the study seeks to investigate whether it is feasible to use these biomarkers to predict the extent of recovery that patients may achieve.
